think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s documented domain (allowed range/units) and default. 2) Check whether any specific numeric value(s) (e.g., -1, 0) are documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/sentinel), rather than just being a smaller/larger amount. 3) If such sentinel values exist, classify as a special knob and list those values; otherwise classify as non-special.
